metaDescription: Download the clockin.it apps: time clock with face recognition and geolocation, a shared kiosk and employee management.
heroTitleLead: Clocking in made fast, secure and
heroLead: Record the workday from a phone, a computer or a shared kiosk, with face recognition and geolocation, integrated with your company's time and attendance system.
heroNote: Available for Android, iOS and macOS. Windows and Linux coming soon.
appsLead: Each app takes care of one part of the workday, and all of them talk to the same clockin.it system.
appSubtitle: Fast, secure and simple clocking in
appSummary: Clock in quickly, securely and simply, with the identification features defined by your company.
appFeature1: Clock in, clock out and every other punch of the workday
appFeature2: Face recognition, when enabled by the company
appFeature4: A view of the punches already recorded
kioskSubtitle: Face-based time clock in a single kiosk
kioskSummary: A shared time clock terminal: several employees record their punches on a single device.
kioskFeature1: Several employees on a single device
kioskFeature3: An interface dedicated to clocking in
kioskFeature4: Set up and managed from clockin.it admin
appadminSubtitle: Employees, faces and kiosks in one place
appadminSummary: The clockin.it management app: get everything ready so the team can clock in quickly and securely.
appadminFeature4: Configuration of the time clock features
featuresTitle: What clockin.it does for the workday
featuresLead: From the employee's phone to the terminal at the front desk, clocking in is simple for whoever punches and reliable for the company.
featurePunchText: Clock in, clock out and every other punch of the workday, in a few taps.
featureFaceText: Employees identified by their face, when enabled by the company.
featureLocationText: The place of each punch recorded, when configured.
featureKioskText: A single device for the whole team to clock in.
featureManagementText: Employees, faces and kiosks managed from clockin.it admin.
featureSecurityText: Punches that are secure, traceable and integrated with the time and attendance system.
bandText: From registration to the punch, everything in the same system.
howTitle: Three steps, from registration to the punch
howStep1Text: In clockin.it admin, they register the employees, the faces and the kiosks.
howStep2Text: In the app or at the kiosk, with the identification features defined by the company.
howStep3Text: The punches reach the workforce management system, secure and traceable.
downloadTitle: Get the right app for you
downloadLead: Pick the app and the platform. The link always leads to the latest version.
downloadMacosNote: The macOS apps are signed and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 12 or later.
downloadDisclaimer: The available features may vary according to the configuration adopted by the company.
